A '''clone trooper''' served the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as a [[Clone trooper/Legends|soldier]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict waged between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. He was stationed on [[Haurgab]]&mdash;a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]&mdash;in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] during one of the war's many [[Battle of Haurgab|battles]]. There, along with the rest of the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on Haurgab, he fought against the planet's Separatist-aligned [[Maujasi]]. The [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the [[Hadde Base|base]] he was located in took a direct hit from a [[Huntmaster missile|missile]].

==Biography==
[[File:DS_Scorch.png|thumb|225px|The clone's death heavily impacted Scorch (pictured).]]
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] was one of many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]]<ref name="O66" /> of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="SWE" /> He, along with all of his clone brothers, fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="O66" /> a conflict [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|starting]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> in which the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] battled the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] for control of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. He participated in a [[Battle of Haurgab|battle]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planet [[Haurgab]] during this war. On Haurgab, as part of the Republic clone [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] stationed there, he fought against the [[Maujasi]] clans, Humans [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to Haurgab who had allied themselves with the Separatists.<ref name="O66" />

The [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] was in the mess hall at the Republic-controlled [[Hadde Base]]<ref name="O66" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> when a [[Hadde Maujasi rebels|pro-Separatist group]] launched a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] strike from within the Republic-friendly [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Hadde]]. One [[Huntmaster missile|missile]] directly hit the front entrance of the base, in which the mess hall was located, and the resulting explosion flung metal trays from a rack across the room, striking the trooper and one of his [[Unidentified clone trooper 2 (Haurgab)|comrades]]. The impact cut off the top of the trooper's head, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him instantly, while the other trooper lost one of his [[Limb/Legends|legs]] when a tray cut through it.<ref name="O66" />

The trooper's death heavily impacted Republic [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]], who witnessed the event. Scorch believed no man should die while trying to get a bite to eat. He later took out his rage on those who launched the missile that killed the trooper, participating in the [[Raid on Hadde|raid]] that captured and killed the ones responsible. Scorch then lined up the dead bodies of the enemy and sprayed them with [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire.<ref name="O66" />

==Personality and traits==
Like all clones of the [[Clone template/Legends|prime clone]] Jango Fett, the trooper stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="SWE" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> He also shared much of the same main features of other clone troopers, such as their complexion and basic look.<ref name="O66" />

==Behind the scenes==
The trooper first appeared in the fourth novel of the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]], [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], written by [[Karen Traviss]] and released in [[2008]].<ref name="O66" />
